resources.string: Here are the changes in this version. Your settings are preserved.
Hub aligned with app rows: dot and label share the same columns without extra horizontal insets.
The dot column stays reserved with no notifications or with the indicator disabled, so the label does not shift.
Corrected previews: the super compact layout no longer inherits menu-only leading spaces.
Background size can reach zero: the panel disappears and the row follows app spacing without a button minimum height.
